description: Na₆Sn₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SnO₅ square pyramid, corners with nine NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with three equivalent SnO₅ square pyramids, and edges with four NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent SnO₅ square pyramids, corners with six NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent SnO₅ square pyramids, and edges with five NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SnO₅ square pyramids, corners with nine NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent SnO₅ square pyramids, and edges with four NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.41 Å. Sn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted SnO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SnO₅ square pyramid, corners with seven NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one SnO₅ square pyramid, and edges with seven NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.22 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form distorted ONa₅Sn octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids, edges with eight ONa₅Sn octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Sn atoms to form ONa₄Sn₂ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONa₄Sn₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids, edges with seven ONa₅Sn octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-21°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted ONa₄Sn square pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₅Sn octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids, and edges with five ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-93°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Sn atoms to form ONa₄Sn₂ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₄Sn₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids, edges with six ONa₅Sn octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Sn square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-21°.
